source.title: OMG Systems Modeling Language (SysML) Version 2.0, Part 1: Language Specification

scope.notes: Eight complete SysML source blocks are retained as fixtures. KerML-only blocks and blocks containing literal omission markers are retained only as exclusions.

review_method: Rendered physical pages 435-440 were visually inspected by a human. PDF text extraction was used only for navigation and token cross-checking; rendered layout determined source-block boundaries and the D2/d block is retained as one source panel.

status_vocabulary.kerml_only: The source block is explicitly introduced as KerML and is outside the SysML fixture scope.
